description: Compute a sales commission from either a flat percent rate applied to the whole sale amount, or a tiered (marginal) rate structure where each tier applies only to the slice of the sale amount within it, the same way progressive tax brackets work. An optional base salary is added to the commission to get a total payout. Pure arithmetic, no live data.

baseSalary.description: Optional base salary added to the commission to get totalPayout, default 0

flatRatePercent.description: A flat commission rate as a percent, applied to the whole salesAmount. Mutually exclusive with tiers.

salesAmount.description: The total sale amount commission is computed on

tiers.description: Marginal commission tiers, sorted ascending by upTo. Mutually exclusive with flatRatePercent.

ratePercent.description: Commission rate as a percent applied to the slice of salesAmount within this tier

upTo.description: Upper bound of this tier (exclusive). null means unbounded and is only valid on the last tier.

name: calculate_sales_commission
